reference_numeric_representation_audit.bound_reason: Identical-knot-time linear interpolation is convex; reverse triangle inequalities bound same-sample XY RMSE and peak changes by the maximum reference-knot vector difference.

material_audit.scope: Numeric native robot/bound-ground material readbacks; USD scene addresses omitted; original report SHA-256 retained

objective_contract.sideslip_target: held reference body-frame course angle, NOT zero
objective_contract.reference_order: Freeze reference[k] and relative-body targets at pre-action state; evaluate after decimation, before command advances.
objective_contract.pose_semantics: World link-origin position and link wxyz quaternion
objective_contract.velocity_semantics: World original-unmerged-link COM linear velocity and world angular velocity
objective_contract.cost: dt * (sum_positive_reward_weights - sum(weight * raw_term)); no terminal term supplied
surrogate_differences: MuJoCo net contact forces are not identical to PhysX ContactSensor forces; all contacts, including self-contact, are included.
undesired_contacts uses max norm over supplied physical-substep history; omitted history is explicitly an instantaneous surrogate.
MuJoCo-derived 0.95 joint ranges are an approximation unless replaced by Isaac runtime soft_joint_pos_limits in matching joint order.
Body COM offsets/inertias must match the original unmerged USD links; random COM offsets require the same realized model parameters.
Task tilt safety termination and policy action/observation privileges are outside this stage objective.

packed_state_contract.algorithmic_memory: Physical-substep contact-force history plus first-reward reset flag; not extra robot state or actuators.
packed_state_contract.excluded_integration_state: qacc warm-start and simulator time are cold-reset per prediction interval; no actuator activation state exists in this model.
packed_state_contract.external_applied_forces: Required zero in both predictor and plant; no prescribed root correction.

action_parameterization.baseline: Winning bounded initial FULL plan, or bounded fallback when all initial scores fail; fresh after each warm shift
action_parameterization.zero_residual: Exactly represents the initial baseline, not a later improved incumbent
action_parameterization.incumbent: Paired stored best encoded residual and decoded full plan
action_parameterization.elite_moments: Encoded clipped residual parameters; never re-compress decoded/clipped actions
action_parameterization.finite_validation: Before residual encoding clip, before decoded action clip, and for elite moment arithmetic; invalid arithmetic raises
action_parameterization.generic_bounds: New mode rejects nonfinite spans and rounded spans failing endpoint saturation; decoded sums must still be finite

controller_contract.contact_slip_definition: Per-wheel force-weighted contact-point lateral-speed RMS; >threshold normal force, ground-filtered. Zero with no active contact is unavailable, not rolling.

limitations: Separate CARLA S-avoidance supplement; never pooled with the primary large-angle turn or described as physical-car capture.
One seed per condition, descriptive development, not controller-class ranking or a robustness/stability certificate.
Same numeric friction does not calibrate equivalent tire/contact physics across engines. Measured contact absence is not proof of flight.
XY screen only; speed, posture, height and heading/slip are continuous descriptive signals, not added gates.
PPO/SAC use learned 51-dimensional observations; NMPC uses privileged measured state and preview with different compute. No real-time actuation delay is modeled.
